versions.content: If parameter FrIf_ChnlIdx of FrIf_GetTransceiverMode has an in- valid value and if development error detection is enabled (i.e. FrIfDevErrorDetect equals ON), the function FrIf_GetTransceiverMode shall report development error code FRIF_E_INV_CHNL_IDX to the Det_ReportError service of the DET module.
